_doc: Base defence plans (difficulty.defense names one). Items are built one after another once startAfter (s) passed, every structure role in `requires` exists and the team has more than minOre spare ore. Directions: 'front' points from the HQ towards the approach (last known enemy base, else the map centre); angleOffset (rad) turns it. tower: `count` armed buildings (@tower) at `distance`, spread sideways by `spread` rad. wall: a straight line of `posts` posts (@wallPost) centred on the point at `distance`, across the direction; `turrets` = turrets (@turret) on its posts, middle posts first. funnel (killbox): two wall arms leave a `gap` wide passage at `distance`; each arm has `armPosts` posts and leans towards the enemy by `flare` (0 = straight across, 1 = 45°); `turretsPerArm` turrets on the posts next to the gap; towers of the plan stand behind the gap. edgeWall (AI v2, flank closing): starts at `distance` from the HQ in the direction turned by angleOffset and runs straight outwards to the map edge (its last segment is cut there, Walls.planWallLine); skipped when the edge is farther than maxLength; `turrets` on the posts nearest the base. Lines are checked with the game's own placeWall check (Walls.checkWallCommand) and shifted sideways up to AI.wallTries times.
